item.title: Pope Leo calls out Trump’s Iran rhetoric before last-minute ceasefire emerges
item.summary: Pope Leo called President Trump's threat against Iran 'truly unacceptable,' urging world leaders to return to the negotiating table and reject war always.

item.title: Trump agrees to 2-week ceasefire if Iran opens Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: President Donald Trump announces a two-week delay of a planned Iran strike following talks with Pakistani leaders and progress toward a potential agreement with Iran.

item.title: Daylight hammer attack suspect is illegal alien released under Biden policies: DHS
item.summary: Haitian illegal immigrant Rolbert Joachim allegedly bludgeoned a mother to death with a hammer outside a Florida gas station. DHS says he was released under the Biden administration.

item.title: Athena Strand photo shows deadly ride with FedEx driver who admitted killing girl during Christmas delivery
item.summary: FedEx driver Tanner Horner admitted to the capital murder of Athena Strand, 7, after allegedly abducting her during a delivery at her father's home.

item.title: Abortion pill mifepristone stays available by mail for now as FDA faces 6-month review deadline
item.summary: A federal judge ruled mifepristone can still be mailed nationwide for now but warned the abortion pill's FDA guidelines could face major changes soon.

item.title: Swalwell campaign rejects 'outrageous' allegations of sexual misconduct as Dem activists issue viral warning
item.summary: Rep. Eric Swalwell denied alleged misconduct claims from Cheyenne Hunt as California governor's race heats up ahead of the May primary election.

item.title: Popular far-left streamer unleashes profane tirade against Vietnamese communist refugee in resurfaced vid
item.summary: A video of far-left Twitch streamer Hasan Piker hurling F-bombs at a South Vietnamese communist refugee resurfaced on X, sparking renewed scrutiny on the figure.

item.title: Trump-backed Republican pads GOP's fragile House majority by winning showdown for MTG's former seat
item.summary: Republican Clay Fuller wins Georgia's 14th Congressional District special election, reinforcing the GOP's slim 218-214 House majority for Speaker Johnson.

item.title: Biden wanted to drive reliable energy 'into a ditch,' says Trump Energy Secretary
item.summary: Energy Secretary Chris Wright claimed Tuesday that the Biden administration was driving the U.S. energy system "into a ditch" through massive subsidies.

item.title: American couple chasing retirement dream in Bahamas boating mystery were 'inexperienced': Friend
item.summary: Lynette Hooker, 55, vanished in the Bahamas after her husband claims she fell off a boat. Her daughter alleges a history of domestic violence.
